_about: Price negotiation in the chat, after the plan is shown. The first polite_refusals requests get no discount (the owner is shown the cheaper Basic plan and longer contracts instead); if they insist, first_offer_pct, then max_discount_pct; after that a salesperson calls. Offers come from these numbers, never from the AI, and a discount never takes a price below the catalogue minimum, whatever these say.

pay_ahead_saving_pct._about: Paying every 3, 6 or 12 months in advance saves this much on the monthly price (never below the catalogue minimum).

welcome._about: First-time customers only (not already with Accel). Order size = monthly price before GST and discounts. The first-months discount covers the first 3 months (monthly or quarterly billing) or the first half-yearly / yearly bill, once; it is a time-limited promotion, so it may go below the catalogue minimum.
